tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Search the shop catalogue. Returns matching products with their slugs, price and stock availability. Use get-product for full details and variants.

tools.name: get-product
tools.description: Get a product's full details by slug: description, options, and every variant with its SKU, price and stock. Variant IDs are what you add to a basket.

tools.name: create-basket
tools.description: Create a new basket. Returns a basket_token — keep it and pass it to every basket and checkout tool. Treat it as a secret.

tools.name: add-to-basket
tools.description: Add a product variant to a basket. Get variant IDs from get-product. Returns the updated basket.

tools.name: view-basket
tools.description: View a basket: its lines, quantities and subtotal.

tools.name: update-basket-item
tools.description: Change the quantity of a basket line. A quantity of 0 removes it. Returns the updated basket.

tools.name: remove-from-basket
tools.description: Remove a line from a basket. Returns the updated basket.

tools.name: apply-discount-to-basket
tools.description: Apply a discount code to a basket. Returns the updated basket with the discount reflected in the totals.

tools.name: list-shipping-methods
tools.description: List available delivery methods, optionally filtered by destination country (ISO 2-letter code). Use the method ID in start-checkout.

tools.name: start-checkout
tools.description: Turn a basket into an order and get payment links. Two ways to pay: a human pay_url (pay-by-bank, the customer authorises in their banking app) and, when offered, an x402_payment_url for autonomous USDC settlement with no human needed. tools.name: get-order-status
tools.description: Check an order's status. Requires the order number AND the email it was placed with.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create-basket" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a new basket. Returns a basket_token — keep it and pass it to every basket and checkout tool. Treat it as a secret.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "shop" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-order-status · Private data: create-basket · Public sink: get-order-status · Destructive: remove-from-basket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-order-status · Private data: create-basket · Public sink: get-order-status · Destructive: remove-from-basket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
